name: Citizenship by Descent

qualifying_event.description: A person born outside the Federation whose parent or grandparent was born in Saint Kitts and Nevis is entitled to apply for citizenship by descent.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; parent's or grandparent's birth certificate/proof of birth in the Federation.

requirements.blocker_text: A parent OR grandparent must have been born in Saint Kitts and Nevis.
Applicants must first obtain a Certificate of Citizenship before becoming eligible for a passport; this process can take up to 6 months.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for and obtain the Certificate of Citizenship.

evidence_required.document: Parent's or grandparent's birth certificate/proof of birth in the Federation

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Government of Saint Kitts and Nevis -- Types of Citizenship: five pathways (descent, marriage, registration, residence, investment); descent requires a parent OR grandparent born in the Federation; Certificate of Citizenship required before passport eligibility, up to 6 months

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Saint Kitts and Nevis' initial build. Unlike Trinidad and Tobago's descent rule (capped at one generation born abroad), this source explicitly extends to a GRANDPARENT born in the Federation, meaning descent-based citizenship reaches at least two generations born outside the territory -- flagged as a materially different (broader) descent rule than T&T's. No further generational limit was stated or implied on this source; if one exists it was not found.
